findings.text: blocking: benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 resolves the persisted panel under FIGURE_ROOT, but this module's private_root fixture (tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py:107) patches only certificate.ROOT, so three tests that passed at base now fail at head (test_two_renders_of_one_revision_move_the_container_and_not_the_panel, test_a_deliberately_altered_panel_does_not_satisfy_the_content_pin, test_the_render_stage_writes_into_the_served_figure_tree) and a plain run of the module writes panel.png/panel.svg into the tracked docs/figures/gs-absolute-accuracy/solovev tree — the defect class the node set out to remove, reintroduced in a module the node's gate never ran.

follow-on: the log the manifest cites as the head raster arm declares revision 18152a0d569d376ba65eba20bf172cc27ae4106f (the node base) at raster-head-alone.log:1 while the evidence fragment calls the same 1186.29 s arm 357e8231c, and the base arm raster-base-alone.log:1 ran at 7c4a76cafa41f4f5a4da06af19a0f0aac3271560 rather than the node base 18152a0d, so the 750.72/1186.29 s pair does not compare the node's base and head.

follow-on: the receipt now writes to tmp_path, but no committed assertion fails if a tracked-path write is reintroduced, so the diagnostics half of the goal has no durable guard; the renderer half is guarded only indirectly by the certificate pin test, as the run's own negative control shows.

gate_arms_note: The reviewed manifest carries both suite arms over the same three modules. baseline_suite revision 18152a0d569d376ba65eba20bf172cc27ae4106f exit 1 with failure ids tests/test_certificate_pin.py::test_pinned_certificate_retains_its_census_and_render_integrity and ::test_pinned_certificate_refuses_unqualified_production_rows (hygiene-gate-base.log: 2 failed, 3 passed); after_suite revision 357e8231c4872ce7be6487eafc67afbb2dc8ae45 exit 1 with failure id ::test_pinned_certificate_refuses_unqualified_production_rows (hygiene-gate-after.log: 1 failed, 4 passed). Added failures over the named logs are zero; the one remaining failure is pre-existing and unrelated (the pinned production receipt carries fifteen unqualified rows). The gate does not run tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py, which the change reddens by three tests.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when requires the three named modules run in one process with git status clean and the pin test passing plus a negative control; hygiene-gate-after.log records 1 failed 4 passed with test_pinned_certificate_retains_its_census_and_render_integrity passing and hygiene-negative-control.log records the tracked PNG dirtied (EXIT=1), but the gate omits tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py, which the change breaks.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal names two figure-receipt tests and one raster timeout; tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py:706 writes its receipt to tmp_path and benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 resolves a persisted panel under FIGURE_ROOT, so both named writers leave the tracked tree, and the raster timeout is reported as a concurrency artefact.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits 357e8231c4872ce7be6487eafc67afbb2dc8ae45 and 79b08252726938a494227fcaf369b2982d9935e6, both suite arms with module-qualified failure ids, six named logs and a negative-control path, but its raster head arm log names revision 18152a0d, not the head.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest fences tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py, tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py, benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py, the fragment and a figures directory; git diff 18152a0d569d376ba65eba20bf172cc27ae4106f..357e8231c4872ce7be6487eafc67afbb2dc8ae45 changes benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py and tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py, all inside them.

justifications.durability: the certificate pin test at tests/test_certificate_pin.py guards the renderer only indirectly (the run's negative control at hygiene-negative-control.log shows it fires when the tracked panel is rewritten), and tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py:706 has no committed assertion that fails if a tracked-path receipt write returns.
justifications.evidence: hygiene-gate-after.log records 1 failed 4 passed over the three named modules with a clean tracked tree and the pin test passing and hygiene-negative-control.log records the PNG dirtied (EXIT=1), but the gate omits tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py, where a base-vs-head reproduction shows three added failures.
justifications.fit: benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 honours the module FIGURE_ROOT that benchmarks/exact_clip_memory_scaling.py:274 already overrides, and tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py:706 uses the pytest tmp_path idiom, so the change follows the surrounding conventions.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py:706 writes to tmp_path and benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 honours FIGURE_ROOT, but the same resolution reddens tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py, so the goal to stop tests writing into tracked figure files is only partly met.
justifications.reuse: `_figure_receipts` at benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:1996 gained a keyword-only logical argument in place rather than a parallel helper, and `_render_persisted_row` reuses the existing FIGURE_ROOT owner, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 18152a0d569d376ba65eba20bf172cc27ae4106f..357e8231c4872ce7be6487eafc67afbb2dc8ae45 touches only benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py and tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py, both declared write paths, and edits no other file.
